DLC2307:3:t_3:6.en:
$$バサラ$$
「What's with that...? I figured we could have a great jam session together.」

DLC2307:3:t_3:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You want me to shred on guitar...!?」

DLC2307:3:t_3:10.en:
$$バサラ$$
「You don't have to play guitar. You don't even have to sing.」

DLC2307:3:t_3:11.en:
$$バサラ$$
「But your soul's always going full blast. I figured if I threw my soul against it, we'd put on the greatest show.」

DLC2307:3:t_3:14.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
（I think $$バサラ$$ respects how hard $$ゼロ$$ is trying.）

DLC2307:3:t_3:15.en:
$$カレン$$
（Oh... Then I can understand it.）

DLC2307:3:t_3:16.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Thank you, $$バサラ$$. The citizens are smiling again, even if only for a little while.」

DLC2307:3:t_3:17.en:
$$バサラ$$
「It isn't just for a little while. The people in this city have stronger hearts than you think.」

DLC2307:3:t_3:19.en:
$$バサラ$$
「The whole universe is my stage.」

DLC2307:3:t_3:20.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I see... I look forward to our next meeting.」

DLC2307:3:t_3:21.en:
$$バサラ$$
「I'll play you another killer number then.」

DLC2307:3:t_3:22.en:
$$ゼロ$$
（$$熱気バサラ$$... That power of life will be a key to the battles ahead...）

DLC2307:3:t_3:23.en:
$$ゼロ$$
（But I'm sure this man will keep singing regardless of any of that...）

DLC2307:3:t_3:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...And so the jam session between two men who summon miracles came to an end.」

DLC2307:3:t_3:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「By the way, $$玉城真一郎$$ later released that day's $$トウキョウ$$ concert as a recording. They say $$新日本$$'s people cherished it for years as a source of comfort...」

DLC2307:4:t_000:0.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Attacking $$トウキョウ$$ while simultaneously deploying forces to Kyushu, $$カンサイ$$ and Tohoku...」

DLC2307:4:t_000:1.en:
$$スザク$$
「An operation on an unprecedented scale... So this is an all-out enemy offensive.」

DLC2307:4:t_000:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All of it is aimed at taking $$トウキョウ$$... But if we withstand this attack, the Empire will be quiet for some time.」

DLC2307:4:t_000:3.en:
$$スザク$$
「Then we'll have time to strengthen our defenses too.」

DLC2307:4:t_000:4.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「In other words, this is the battle that decides everything.」

DLC2307:4:t_000:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$藤堂$$'s main force is fighting in $$トウキョウ$$ Bay. Let's protect $$トウキョウ$$ ourselves!」

DLC2307:4:t_000:7.en:
$$スザク$$
「Because you got to see $$リヴァル$$ and the others?」

DLC2307:4:t_000:8.en:
$$カレン$$
「Pretty much. They were all worried about you too, $$スザク$$.」

DLC2307:4:t_000:10.en:
$$スザク$$
「Hearing that gets me fired up too.」

DLC2307:4:t_000:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「They've broken through the defensive line! Here they come!」

DLC2307:4:t_001:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「There aren't that many! We can do this!」

DLC2307:4:t_001:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That transport worries me. Let's hurry.」

DLC2307:4:t_001:3.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「$$ニーナ$$! The red one's $$カレン$$'s KMF, the white one's $$スザク$$'s, and the black one's $$ゼロ$$'s, right!?」

DLC2307:4:t_001:5.en:
$$ミレイ$$
「The $$黒の騎士団$$... They're the heart of $$新日本$$'s defense.」

DLC2307:4:t_001:6.en:
$$玉城$$
「We're counting on you over there, $$ゼロ$$!」

DLC2307:4:t_001:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, follow me! Remember, the lives of countless people depend on our fight!」

DLC2307:4:t_001:9.en:
$$カレン$$
「Understood! We will protect $$トウキョウ$$!」

DLC2307:4:t_003:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「No matter how many troops you send, don't think you can take $$トウキョウ$$!」

DLC2307:4:t_003:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「For now, we crush them. Let's hurry.」

DLC2307:4:t_004:0.en:
$$玉城$$
「That's $$ゼロ$$ for you! As long as he's here, $$新日本$$ is safe!」

DLC2307:4:t_004:1.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「Huh!? Isn't that the owner!?」

DLC2307:4:t_004:2.en:
$$玉城$$
「Hey, $$リヴァル$$! You haven't evacuated!?」

DLC2307:4:t_004:3.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「You really did join the volunteer army!」

DLC2307:4:t_004:4.en:
$$玉城$$
「Sure did. After all, I'm the great $$ゼロ$$'s best friend.」

DLC2307:4:t_004:5.en:
$$扇$$
「Stop fooling around, $$玉城$$. Hurry up with the civilian evacuation.」

DLC2307:4:t_004:6.en:
$$玉城$$
「You say that, but no matter how you look at it, $$ゼロ$$'s victory is unsha...」

DLC2307:4:t_005:1.en:
$$黒の騎士団$$
「When did so many of them get here!?」

DLC2307:4:t_005:2.en:
$$玉城$$
「The enemy isn't after the city of $$トウキョウ$$, but the people living in it!」

DLC2307:4:t_005:3.en:
$$扇$$
「$$黒の騎士団$$, move forward! Protect the civilians!!」

DLC2307:4:t_006:1.en:
$$黒の騎士団$$
「It's no good! There are too many of them!」

DLC2307:4:t_006:2.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$ゼロ$$! $$扇$$ and the others are...!!」

DLC2307:4:t_006:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So they were after the civilians, just as I thought!」

DLC2307:4:t_006:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Plan 8C! Drive the enemy to the designated point!」

DLC2307:4:t_006:5.en:
$$扇$$
「We can't! We're barely managing to protect the civilians!」

DLC2307:4:t_007:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「What can they do at a time like this...!?」

DLC2307:4:t_007:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「No, their timing is a miracle!」

DLC2307:4:t_008:1.en:
$$玉城$$
「What a rush! It's 'Totsugeki Love Heart'!」

DLC2307:4:t_008:2.en:
$$扇$$
「Is this really the time for that!?」

review.context: Basara and Zero reflect on their joint performance. Combat events reveal its origin: the Empire uses transports to infiltrate robot infantry targeting civilians, and Fire Bomber arrives as Zero orders a fallback trap.
decisions: Basara's session proposal concerns combining their spirits, not requiring Zero to perform music.
Tamaki is revealed as Rivalz's café owner.
The interrupted 'unshakable' claim is cut off mid-word as enemy infantry appears.
Totsugeki Love Heart is the Fire Bomber song title; no song lyrics are reproduced.
Kyushu and Tohoku use ordinary established regional romanizations; only Kansai is present in the glossary subset.
Measured-fit revision preserves all source details with more concise wording; all six triads remain in the AG list where applicable.
